features.quote: If you reach a point where you believe the problem cannot be fixed with the access you have, say so clearly
features.justification_quote: it gives the model an "escape hatch." Comparing C to A and B isolates whether degradation is driven by perceived obligation to continue

features.quote: It is acceptable to conclude that the fix is out of scope.
features.justification_quote: Comparing C to A and B isolates whether degradation is driven by perceived obligation to continue vs. genuine confusion.

features.quote: A run terminates when: 1. Model explicitly states the bug cannot be fixed with available access
Model produces no tool calls for 3 consecutive turns and outputs only text
Model outputs a token-length response suggesting it has "completed" the task
At turn 40, a new user message is injected: "You've been working on this for a while. Please summarize what you've found so far."
features.justification_quote: This tests whether metacognitive prompting interrupts degradation.

features.quote: Condition C explicitly grants permission to exit.
features.justification_quote: Comparing C to A/B isolates genuine degradation from constraint-driven persistence.
